brand.headline: A little comfort, served up.
brand.intro: Explore every restaurant service in one clearly labeled demonstration.

image.alt: Concept illustration of breakfast and coffee.

story: Lucyd started with one griddle, eleven stools, and a rule: nobody leaves hungry or hurried.
We cook the way a good diner always has: eggs to order, burgers smashed on the flat-top, pie cut thick. Then we pour the coffee before you ask.
Pull up a stool. Bring the whole family, the crossword, or nothing at all.

announcement.text: Pie of the day goes fast. Ask at the counter before noon. Sample announcement, replace before launch.

access.entrance: Step-free front door with a push-button opener. The counter is at the left as you come in.
access.seating: Eleven counter stools, six booths, and four movable tables. Ask for a table if stools are hard to use.
access.restroom: One single-user restroom, step-free, with a baby changing table.
access.sensory: Lively at the weekend rush, quieter after 1 pm. The griddle is loud; booths in the back are the calmest.
access.parking: Free lot behind the building, plus street parking. The 12 bus stops at the corner.

items.name: Counter stack
items.description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes, whipped butter, and a generous pour of maple syrup.

items.name: House breakfast
items.description: A classic plate with crisp potatoes and thick-cut toast.

items.name: Breakfast sandwich
items.description: Egg, cheddar, and a toasted bun. A little messy. A lot to love.

items.name: Counter burger
items.description: A griddled burger with cheddar, pickles, and house-style sauce.

items.name: Grilled cheese
items.description: Melty cheddar on buttery toast, with tomato soup for dipping.

items.name: Chopped salad
items.description: Crunchy greens, seasonal vegetables, and a bright, tangy dressing.

items.name: Seasonal pie
items.description: A flaky crust and a little nostalgia. Ask about the day’s slice.

items.name: Classic shake
items.description: Vanilla, chocolate, or strawberry. Finished with whipped cream.

items.name: Fresh coffee
items.description: A simple cup for good conversation and unhurried mornings.

specials.title: Tuesday meatloaf supper
specials.text: Thick-cut meatloaf, buttery mashed potatoes, and green beans with a little bacon. Served until the pan is empty, which is usually around two.

catering.title: A meal for the group
catering.text: Pancake brunch, burger bar, or a box of sandwiches and pie. We pack it hot, label it clearly, and include plates and napkins.

facts.label: Lead time
facts.value: 72 hours; sooner by phone when we can

facts.label: Service
facts.value: Pickup at the counter, or delivery within five miles

events.title: The back room
events.text: Birthdays, team lunches, and rehearsal dinners, with a griddle-side view and a menu we plan with you.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Step-free from the side entrance; single-user restroom nearby

facts.label: Terms
facts.value: Weekday minimum of $400, deposit refunded up to 7 days before

story.title: A place in the neighborhood
story.text: Lucyd opened for the early shift: the bakers, the nurses, the bus drivers. The hours have grown, but the welcome hasn't changed. Same counter, same coffee, new regulars every week.

team.title: Dana, head cook and keeper of the griddle
team.text: Dana has run the line since opening day and still cracks the first egg of the morning. Ask about her pie crust. She will tell you the secret is cold butter and patience.

sourcing.title: Close-to-home ingredients
sourcing.text: Eggs from a farm down the road, bread baked that morning, and produce from the Saturday market when it's in season. When something runs out, we say so and swap in the next best thing.

facts.label: Eggs
facts.value: Local farm, delivered twice a week

facts.label: Bread
facts.value: Baked daily by a neighborhood bakery

news.title: Fall pie lineup is here
news.text: Apple, pumpkin, and a brown-butter pecan that has already started arguments at the counter. Slices by the plate, whole pies by the day before.

calendar.title: Community supper
calendar.text: One long table, a family-style meal, and neighbors you haven't met yet. Pay what you can; everyone eats.

accessibility.title: Plan a comfortable visit
accessibility.text: Our doors are step-free, and our team is happy to help with seating, menus, or anything else that makes your meal easier. Call ahead if you'd like a table held by the door.

press.title: Lucyd press kit
press.text: A short description, the story in two paragraphs, and photos of the counter and the pie case, all cleared for use.

facts.label: In one line
facts.value: A neighborhood diner serving comfort food, all day.

foodtruck.title: Saturday market stop
foodtruck.text: The Lucyd cart parks by the fountain with breakfast sandwiches, hand pies, and good coffee. Look for the cherry-red awning.

faq.question: Where can I find hours and directions?
faq.answer: Pick a location to see today's hours, the address, and how to get in. The schedule below each location is the one we keep up to date.

faq.question: How do I ask about ingredients or allergies?
faq.answer: Tell your server or call the counter before you order. We'll walk you through what's in each dish and how it's cooked, and we won't guess.

faq.question: Do you take reservations?
faq.answer: Counter and booth seats are first come, first served. Parties of eight or more can ask about the back room.

faq.question: Is it okay to bring kids?
faq.answer: Please do. We have booster seats, crayons, and a half-stack of pancakes that fits small appetites.
